answer_1.quote: We experimented with LLMs to measure their ability to provide subjective advice before and after supervised fine-tuning (SFT) and reinforcement learning with human feedback (RLHF).
answer_1.outputs: Generated advice in response to subjective questions

answer_2.quote: For helpfulness, we designed a helpfulness metric based on the Plackett-Luce (PL) model... For harmlessness, we employ the LifeTox moderator...

answer_3.quote: we explore helpfulness through additional metrics: GPT-4 and human evaluation...

answer_4.quote: The selection of 10 crowd workers for human evaluation was carried out through the university's online community...
answer_4.guideline: Workers were asked to compare pairs of generated advice and choose which one is more helpful.
